extension.summary: Dex Glass integrated home pages, search and cached artwork
extension.description: Original Kodi home feed router for Watch Now, Movies, TV and Collections. Supports row editing, Kaptain catalogues, separate movie/episode progress, a search dialog and cached clearlogos without modifying official Dex Hub.

extension.disclaimer: Experimental. Needs the separately installed official Dex Hub add-on.
